text.tspan: PlasRisk: A Ten-Dimension Data-Driven Weighted Risk Assessment Framework for Bacterial Plasmids
Workflow schematic — (A) data-driven weight determination and (B) command-line risk scoring
# --no-abricate for sequence-only mode · --json for JSON output
66 typed replicons with pre-computed S_REP / S_GEO / S_HAB / S_GROW / S_HOST
Unknown replicons receive neutral defaults (0.30); prefix matching handles subtypes (e.g., IncFII(K) → IncFII).
Random Forest (300 trees) · LASSO (10-fold CV) · Entropy method · Coordinate-descent grid search
Decile calibration · Decision-curve analysis · Leave-one-replicon-out CV for generalisation across backbones
